claim: A prospectively frozen exact two-surface output-head search evaluated both unit directions for all eight ranked coordinates. Every proposal-descent direction worsened the document-disjoint guard, so the safe set was empty, exact rerun replay passed, the source model was retained, and public development plus all later gates stayed closed.
